name: ts-release
description: Agent skill for driving ts-release: configure, plan, review, diagnose, materialize, and resume staged releases without bypassing its review gates.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, review, and apply staged software releases with ts-release.
interface.longDescription: ts-release plans a release as immutable canonical bytes, reviews it, and applies it through explicit operator-confirmed frontiers. This plugin ships one skill that walks the staged workflow: recon the repository, select supported distribution targets, write strict JSON configuration with credentials by environment name, plan and persist the PlanId, diagnose with the read-only doctor, materialize only after execution review, stop for the publish review, and resume or reconcile safely from the run ledger. It never grants publication authority by itself.
capabilities: Configure ts-release release.config.json for supported targets
Plan canonical release bytes and persist the PlanId
Review and diagnose plans read-only with doctor
Apply through the validation frontier after execution review
Resume interrupted runs and reconcile unknown remote outcomes
defaultPrompt: Set up a ts-release release for this repository and show me the plan without publishing anything.
Run ts-release doctor on my existing release plan and explain every problem it finds.
My ts-release run stopped with an unknown publish outcome. Inspect the run ledger and reconcile it safely.
